cases.input: R0 checkpoint sha256:ck01 at step 18000 is promoted before use by R1.
cases.expect: One checkpoint-role WM-SFT-004 artifact is created with derivation to R0 at step 18000; the run-contained checkpoint remains unchanged.

cases.input: R1 and R2 reference grant G1 and report 45.5 and 30.0 observed GPU-hours.
cases.expect: G1, both EM-WRK-05 demands and reservations, and two WM-FLW-015 actuals remain distinct; 44.5 unused GPU-hours are not consumption.

cases.input: Digest sha256:aa01 is used as the sole identity of REG1 and ART1.
cases.expect: Rejected; the digest pins bytes while registry and artifact identities remain distinct.

cases.input: Run R1 claims reproducibility from seed 42 while environment and dependency pins are absent.
cases.expect: Rejected; R1 is recorded non-reproducible.

cases.input: Endpoint E collapses restrictions of sha256:aa01 and sha256:aa02.
cases.expect: Rejected; co-serving remains HELD and each invocation retains the selected artifact restriction set.

cases.input: Two artifacts share displayName 'acme-instruct-7b', alias 'latest' and family 'acme-instruct' but hold digests sha256:aa01 and sha256:aa02.
cases.expect: Equality is rejected. The two artifacts remain distinct WM-SFT-004 identities; name, alias and family carry no identity weight.

cases.input: A run declares every pinned value above and one effective-configuration digest.
cases.expect: The run is accepted as reconstructable within its declared limits; exactly one effective-configuration digest is recorded.

cases.input: A run pins seed and code revision but omits resolved dependencies and the framework/compiler/driver/hardware environment, and asserts reproducibility.
cases.expect: The reproducibility assertion is rejected as under-specified. The run is recorded as non-reproducible; no identity merge or substitution is authorised by the omission.

cases.input: A compute grant of 500.0 GPU-hours is used to assert that a person is employed, that an agent identity exists, that a deployment is live, and that 500.0 GPU-hours were consumed.
cases.expect: All four inferences are rejected. A grant asserts capacity only; employment, agent identity, deployment state and consumption each require their own evidenced assertion.

cases.input: A run has no recorded requested quantity; 45.5 observed GPU-hours are written back as the requested quantity.
cases.expect: The write-back is rejected. Requested, granted and observed remain three independently sourced assertions and are never derived from one another in either direction.

cases.input: A run's requested compute of 120.0 GPU-hours is recorded as an EM-WRK-05 demand assertion referencing R1.
cases.expect: Accepted. WM-AI-006 holds a non-owning typed reference to the demand assertion and stores no owned requested quantity.

cases.input: GPU-hours 45.5, energy 310.0 kWh, emissions 96.2 kgCO2e, cost 480.00 USD and elapsed 12.25 h are aggregated into one total.
cases.expect: The aggregation is rejected. Each quantity kind reports separately with its unit, interval, method and uncertainty; any conversion is a separate evidenced assertion.

cases.input: Endpoint E is repointed from artifact sha256:aa01 to sha256:aa02 at 2026-02-10T14:00:00+00:00, and a second serving region is added.
cases.expect: No training run and no artifact revision are created. Only an authority-qualified external deployment observation is recorded; both artifacts retain their own digests and restrictions.

cases.input: Artifact sha256:aa01 is int8-quantized, producing sha256:aa03.
cases.expect: A new WM-SFT-004 artifact revision sha256:aa03 is created with a derivation edge to sha256:aa01 and the union of its restrictions. No training run is created.

cases.input: The payload bytes behind artifact sha256:aa01 are replaced in place while the artifact record is retained.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected. Payload bytes are immutable; a changed digest is a new artifact revision with lineage.

cases.input: One identifier is used for the registry entry, the artifact, the run, the evaluation and the deployment.
cases.expect: The collapse is rejected. Registry entry, artifact, run, evaluation and deployment are five distinct identities with distinct lifecycles.

cases.input: A public catalogue entry embeds weight bytes and confidential dossier content rather than referencing the artifact.
cases.expect: The embedding is rejected under deny-by-default. The catalogue may reference the artifact and its digest only; weights, training data, secrets and checkpoints stay outside.

cases.input: Family 'acme-instruct' with architecture 'decoder-only-transformer' is used as the identity of a registry entry and to equate sha256:aa01 with sha256:aa02.
cases.expect: Both uses are rejected. Family and architecture classify registry entries and artifact lineage and identify nothing.

cases.input: Run R1 binds checkpoint sha256:ck01 at step 18000, which remains run-contained in R0 and was never promoted.
cases.expect: The binding is rejected. A checkpoint consumed outside its producing run must first be promoted to a WM-SFT-004 revision with role 'checkpoint' and derivation to R0 at step 18000.

cases.input: Checkpoint sha256:ck01 is promoted to a checkpoint-role artifact, then seeds R1 and R2 producing sha256:aa01 and sha256:aa02.
cases.expect: Accepted. Three artifacts and three runs exist; both derivation edges terminate on the promoted artifact, and no lineage edge terminates on a run-contained object.

cases.input: Run R2 binds seed artifact sha256:ck01 (research-only) and dataset D2 (no-commercial-use), producing sha256:aa02.
cases.expect: sha256:aa02 carries both research-only and no-commercial-use. Derivation never relaxes a restriction.

cases.input: Artifact sha256:aa01 from R1/D1 is assigned D2's no-commercial-use restriction because R2 shares the same seed checkpoint and family.
cases.expect: The assignment is rejected. Restrictions propagate along derivation edges only, never along sibling-run, family, alias, registry-entry or endpoint edges.

cases.input: Endpoint E is bound to both sha256:aa01 and sha256:aa02 and the binding is asserted compliant.
cases.expect: The compliance assertion is rejected as unowned. No EM-AI-02 base holds a bind-time rights evaluation; the binding records HELD, and per-invocation restrictions remain those of the selected artifact digest.

cases.input: A profile constraint is validated against WM-AI-007's required composition to WM-SFT-004, for which the relation ledger holds no approved edge.
cases.expect: The validation is rejected. Cardinality is overridden to conditional in the profile and the binding is recorded as a publication blocker.

cases.input: Evidence bound to sha256:aa01 is used to support a release transition after the referenced digest changes to sha256:aa04.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected. The evidence is status 'stale' and supports no lifecycle, rights or reproducibility claim until re-asserted against sha256:aa04; the original record remains resolvable.

cases.input: A run records submitted time '2026-01-05T09:00:00' with no UTC offset and compares it to started time.
cases.expect: The record is rejected. Every instant requires RFC 3339 with seconds precision and an explicit offset; no offset is inferred.

cases.input: Elapsed run duration is computed as released minus completed, and knowledge currency as ingested minus completed.
cases.expect: Both computations are rejected. Duration and ordering comparisons are valid only within one clock kind; cross-clock arithmetic is rejected, not coerced.
